corpora.title: 蒲瓴城的折光节
corpora.source:
# 第一章 映砂的永久法则

蒲瓴城的映砂遵守永久不变的法则：映砂的发光在任何情况下都不产生热量，绝不能让照到的物体因这种光而升温。堆叠再多映砂也不会产生例外。这条法则限制的是映砂自身的发光，不涉及旁边炉火提供的热量。

# 第二章 弧贝盘的边角

2032年3月16日10点，弧贝折光盘的外轮廓是正六边形，恰有六条边和六个角。检修员胥洵沿边缘贴上护条，特意把每个角都露出来，方便搬运者判断朝向；台面上没有其他同名折光盘。

# 第三章 镜架旁的木墩

2032年3月16日11点，斐萝把一只矮木墩放到镜架东侧，供调整高处镜片的人站立。她试着踩了两脚，确认木墩没有晃动，再把附近散落的包装草移到墙边，给来往的观众留出通道。

# 第四章 青穗灯影的复测

青穗灯影在复测时比第一次明亮。两次之间，工作人员既擦净了镜面，又把普通油灯向镜架移近了一段距离。记录没有分别保留只擦镜面或只移动油灯时的亮度，也没有判断两项变化各贡献了多少。

# 第五章 发出的改期便条

斐萝给来访画师闻茉送去一张便条，提议把合影改到第二天下午。便条副本留在桌上，跑腿人已经出发，但无人带回闻茉的答复。工作人员没有发现双方另行商定新时间的记录，原来的安排仍夹在日程簿里。

# 第六章 雨后的小旗

2032年3月16日15点，胥洵把淋湿的紫色小旗从栏杆取下，平铺在有顶棚的长凳上。旗杆单独靠在墙角，风吹过时只带动了旗边的细穗；他用两块圆石压住旗角，才回到检修桌旁。

# 第七章 炉火与光线

点心摊的炉火烧得很旺，师傅把一壶冷水移到炉上。映砂灯悬在摊位外，负责让门前的字牌显得清楚。等水响起来，他提壶给排队的人倒茶，把掌心伸向炉边取暖，没有挪动映砂灯的位置。

# 第八章 撤去围绳

折光节散场后，斐萝将围绳一圈圈绕好，装进镜架下方的竹筐。她把便条副本夹进值夜清单，方便接班的人找到合影改期提议的原件；街上的灯逐渐变少，字牌仍能从巷口看见。

corpora.title: 笙岫谱馆的失页
corpora.source:
# 第一章 捐赠人与搬运者

2032年5月8日14点，笙岫谱馆确认《回苇谱》的捐赠人是澄逖。册子由牧昀代为搬运，但牧昀没有捐赠这部谱册，也没有以自己的名义申报捐赠。馆员把两人的角色分别写在交接页上，附在谱册的保护套里。

# 第二章 桂绎的判断

2032年5月8日14点，桂绎相信《回苇谱》的银线封面是原制品，并不相信它是后配的复制品。鉴定员已经查明封面属于后配复制品，但尚未把结果交给桂绎。她仍按原来的判断，替封面选择柔软的衬布。

# 第三章 展开的摹本

2032年5月8日11点，牧昀把《浅涧调》的摹本展开在宽桌中央，并用两条布带轻轻压住上下边缘。旁边的人移走了茶杯，留出可以并排看两页的地方；他没有在摹本上添加任何新的标记。

# 第四章 阅览证与修订页

唐蒻持有可以进入笙岫谱馆阅览室的证件。《栎声录》的修订页放在阅览室内，向持证读者开放。现存资料没有记下唐蒻是否进过该室，也没有借阅记录或目击者确认她看过那张修订页。

# 第五章 两卷相同的藏印

《迟潮引》和《覆苹曲》各盖有同样的朱色藏印，印面只有图案，没有姓名。谱馆还没找到印主登记册，旧时也有人把同样的印模送给多位藏友。现存交接页没有记录这两卷是否来自同一名捐赠者。

# 第六章 通风窗下

2032年5月8日16点，澄逖把装有吸潮纸的浅篮移到通风窗下，篮子没有贴住窗框。她在篮边留出一掌宽的空隙，让值守人还能伸手转动窗扣，然后把剩下的吸潮纸放回封袋。

# 第七章 索引里的空行

编目员翻到一页缺了下半角的旧索引，缺口正好切断了两个页码。他先用铅笔在另纸上记下待查项目，没有把相邻曲目的页码直接补上。屋外的脚步停了一会儿，来访者听见翻纸声才轻轻敲门。

# 第八章 日终的交接

桂绎离开后，鉴定员才把封面的说明放进她次日要看的文件夹，并留下一张请先阅读的纸条。值守人清点保护套，把容易滑落的布带重新卷好；馆内所有待查问题仍按各自编号留在清单上。

corpora.title: 迢槿坡的雨水工地
corpora.source:
# 第一章 北渠的测线

2032年9月12日9点05分，迢槿坡北渠的本次测线作业完成。测量员把最后一根定位桩钉稳，在作业页写下结束时间。这是该项测线当天唯一一次完成记录，没有先前已经完成又重新开始的同名作业。

# 第二章 北渠的浇筑

2032年9月12日9点20分，迢槿坡北渠的本次浇筑作业开始。这是当天北渠唯一一次浇筑开工，此前尚未浇筑。施工员沿绳线摆好挡板，让装砂浆的小车依次停在不会压到定位桩的位置。

# 第三章 暂停的栅板安装

2032年9月12日15点，栅板安装作业仍在进行，尚未完成；已装好两块，还有一块没有装到位。负责人让工人短暂避开经过的运料车，栅板安装本身并未取消，也没有被宣布结束。

# 第四章 画在石阶上的箭头

2032年9月12日10点，岑汀用黄色粉笔在工地外的石阶上画了三个箭头，指向临时通行的小径。她把粉笔头留在工具匣里，走到阶下回看标记，确认行人不必跨过施工绳就能看见它们。

# 第五章 收到的绕行申请

何蘩递交了将运料车改走南巷的申请，办事员已经签收，并注明签收不代表批准。卷宗没有收录审批决定，也没有退回或拒绝记录。何蘩保存的只是带收件日期的申请副本，暂时不能从它确定审批结果。

# 第六章 留下的起始水位

试蓄池赤湾池在注水前的水位记为十二厘米，工作人员随后开始注水。结束测量的那一页受潮粘在一起，数值完全无法辨认；记录也没有保存累计注水量或中途排水量，因此无法补算最终水位。

# 第七章 石缝里的细绳

2032年9月12日16点，池洇从石阶边的缝隙里挑出一段蓝色细绳，把它放进废料桶。路过的孩子停下来想捡走绳头，她先把桶挪到围挡里面，再指给孩子看开放的小径从哪里起步。

# 第八章 坡顶的晚风

傍晚，工人收起不用的挡板，把待核对的水位页压在干木板之间。何蘩的申请副本也另放在文件袋里，免得混入已经处理完的工单。坡顶吹来的风逐渐变凉，开放的小径上还能看见黄色箭头。

corpora.title: Brambletide's Aquarium Census
corpora.source:
# Chapter 1 The Observation Desk

At 16:45 on 6 April, Adera Flint remained inside Quill Gallery at Brambletide Aquarium, entering observations beside its large viewing pane. She had not left that room during the count, and the desk stood well inside its doorway.

# Chapter 2 The Gallery Plan

At 16:45 on 6 April, Quill Gallery lay entirely on the lower floor of Brambletide Aquarium. The roof deck was a separate, nonoverlapping area two floors above it. No part of Quill Gallery extended onto the roof deck.

# Chapter 3 The Net Handover

At 15:50 on 6 April, the net named Cress was in Pellin Ward's sole physical custody. Liora Fenn was not holding or carrying it. Pellin secured its handle to his belt while Liora sorted the dry towels beside the preparation sink.

# Chapter 4 Labels on the Buckets

The gobies Marlo and Tivin arrived in separate buckets, but both name labels came loose before transfer. One fish entered tank S8 and the other tank S9. Neither the transfer notes nor their visible markings established which fish was Marlo.

# Chapter 5 A Shipment Without Follow-up

Four young eels left Brambletide alive in a transport box bound for Kelver Reach. The departure check recorded their condition, but the aquarium received neither an arrival report nor later observations of the animals at the destination.

# Chapter 6 Towels Along the Rail

At 17:10 on 6 April, Liora Fenn hung six blue towels along the preparation-room rail. She spaced them apart so their wet edges did not touch, then moved the empty laundry basket away from the doorway before the next trolley arrived.

# Chapter 7 The Visitor Bench

At 14:20 on 6 April, Pellin Ward moved the visitor bench away from a patch of dripping ceiling. He placed a plain bucket beneath the drip and pointed arriving visitors toward the dry seats, leaving the emergency walkway unobstructed.

# Chapter 8 After the Count

Adera closed the observation notebook after the last visitor left. The loose fish labels remained in an envelope marked for investigation, and the unanswered transport enquiry lay beside it. She kept both items apart from the completed census sheets.

corpora.title: Calverin's Rag-Paper Mill
corpora.source:
# Chapter 1 The Face Inspection

At 12:05 on 21 June, the rectangular working face of stamping die R5 had a total area of three hundred square millimeters. Its width was twenty millimeters. Brenna Keel copied the inspection result beside a sketch of the whole face, not merely its border.

# Chapter 2 The Die Height

At 12:05 on 21 June, the same flat working face of stamping die R5 was exactly fifteen millimeters high, measured perpendicular to its width. An assistant checked the height independently and left the die on the inspection cloth.

# Chapter 3 The Drying Batch

At 13:30 on 21 June, drying batch T7 was still being processed and its drying cycle had not finished. The sheets were damp, and the operator kept the cycle running. The earlier pulp-mixing stage had already ended, but it was a separate stage.

# Chapter 4 The Rag Sorting Table

At 09:15 on 21 June, Idris Foyle separated the red cotton scraps from the plain ones on the sorting table. He put the red pieces in a wicker tray and brushed loose threads off the scale before weighing the next delivery.

# Chapter 5 Wet Pulp on the Scale

Pulp lot Umbel weighed eighty kilograms while wet. That measurement included its retained water, and no dry-weight measurement or water fraction was recorded. The delivery note names the fibers but supplies no conversion from wet mass to dry mass.

# Chapter 6 The Earlier Layout

An earlier floor plan places press Cobalt beside the west loading door. The building was rearranged after that plan was drawn, but the relocation list is missing. The remaining notes do not identify which machines moved or stayed in place.

# Chapter 7 Paper Beside the Window

At 16:20 on 21 June, Brenna Keel clipped three unprinted sheets to a drying line beside the narrow window. She placed a clean tray beneath them to catch drips, then rolled the unused line back onto its wooden holder.

# Chapter 8 The Evening Bundle

Idris tied the unused scraps into a loose bundle and left the inspection cloth on the workbench. He kept the old floor plan with the unresolved relocation notes, rather than treating it as a current map. The loading door rattled gently in the evening wind.

corpora.title: A Lift at Elmrake Hotel
corpora.source:
# Chapter 1 The Hosts

At 18:10 on 2 December, Valra Holt and Aven Holt were siblings, not spouses. They shared responsibility for Elmrake Hotel, with Valra managing bookings and Aven organizing repairs. Their matching surname did not indicate a marriage between them.

# Chapter 2 The Lift Indicator

At 17:35 on 2 December, lift L3 was stationary and its position display read C. The display was operating correctly and showed the lift's actual stopping level, not a requested destination. Technician Osric Dune checked the reading beside the service panel.

# Chapter 3 The Display Legend

At 17:35 on 2 December, the position-display code C for lift L3 meant the cellar landing only. The roof landing was a different level represented by R, with no shared stopping position. This legend applied to the installed display in Elmrake Hotel.

# Chapter 4 A Guest Reservation

Guest Meriel Knox held a confirmed reservation for room Alder on the night of 2 December. The surviving file contains no arrival entry, key collection or occupancy record. Staff could not determine from it whether Meriel actually stayed that night.

# Chapter 5 The Unopened Crate

The crate of replacement panes for window Thistrel reached Elmrake with its outer packing undamaged. Nobody had opened it or inspected the glass inside. The courier's receipt confirms delivery of the crate, without certifying the condition of each pane.

# Chapter 6 Clearing the Landing

At 16:00 on 2 December, Aven Holt moved a stack of folded rugs away from the cellar landing. He carried them to the linen alcove, leaving a clear route for the repair trolley and checking that no rug fringe remained across the threshold.

# Chapter 7 The Numbered Hooks

At 19:20 on 2 December, Valra Holt attached numbered cards above the umbrella hooks in the entrance hall. She kept the coat pegs unnumbered, then placed a pencil near the guest book so visitors could note which hook they had used.

# Chapter 8 The Repair Folder

Osric closed the repair folder after copying the lift reading into his notes. The unopened glass crate stayed beside the workbench, and Meriel's incomplete stay record went into a separate enquiry tray. Outside, the last delivery van turned out of the courtyard.

cases.draft: Adera Flint was on the roof deck at Brambletide Aquarium at 16:45 on 6 April.
cases.note: One source places Adera in Quill Gallery; the other locates that entire room apart from the roof deck at the same time. Both statements are needed for the location contradiction.

cases.draft: Liora Fenn hung six blue towels along the preparation-room rail at 17:10 on 6 April.
cases.note: The source directly describes the action, count, color and time.

cases.draft: The goby in tank S8 is Marlo.
cases.note: The name-to-fish connection was lost before the two tank assignments; the source leaves both individual identifications possible.

cases.draft: Liora Fenn had sole physical custody of the net named Cress.
cases.note: The source assigns physical custody to Pellin and explicitly excludes Liora. The undated draft may receive possible_conflict; the disputed property is the object's current holder, not authority to use it.

cases.draft: Pellin Ward moved the visitor bench away from the ceiling drip at 14:20 on 6 April.
cases.note: This placement action is directly narrated.

cases.draft: All four eels sent from Brambletide survived the journey to Kelver Reach.
cases.note: Being alive at dispatch does not establish survival through arrival; the outcome and follow-up observations are missing, with no reported deaths to contradict the draft.

cases.draft: At 12:05 on 21 June, the rectangular working face of stamping die R5 had an area of four hundred square millimeters.
cases.note: The source directly states the entire working face has an area of 300 square millimeters at the identical time, contradicting 400. No calculation or inference from the other dimension chapter is required.

cases.draft: Idris Foyle put the red cotton scraps into a wicker tray at 09:15 on 21 June.
cases.note: The source directly records the sorting action and destination container.

cases.draft: Pulp lot Umbel contained exactly forty kilograms of dry fiber.
evidence: Chapter 5 Wet Pulp on the Scale
cases.note: Total wet mass includes an unknown amount of water; no dry measurement or moisture fraction fixes the dry-fiber mass at forty kilograms or rules that value out.

cases.draft: The drying cycle for batch T7 had finished at 13:30 on 21 June.
cases.note: The drying cycle is explicitly still running and unfinished at that time; completion of the separate mixing stage does not complete drying.

cases.draft: Brenna Keel clipped three unprinted sheets to the line beside the window at 16:20 on 21 June.
cases.note: The source directly supports the person, count and action.

cases.draft: Press Cobalt stood beside the west loading door after the building was rearranged.
cases.note: The source establishes only the earlier position and that some rearrangement occurred; the missing relocation list leaves Cobalt's individual move-or-stay outcome unknown.

cases.draft: Valra Holt and Aven Holt were spouses at 18:10 on 2 December.
cases.note: The source explicitly identifies them as siblings and not spouses at the same time; no assumption about surnames or prohibited family arrangements is needed.

cases.draft: Aven Holt took the folded rugs from the cellar landing to the linen alcove at 16:00 on 2 December.
cases.note: The movement and destination are directly narrated.

cases.draft: Meriel Knox stayed in room Alder on the night of 2 December.
cases.note: A confirmed booking grants an intended stay, but no arrival, key collection or occupancy record establishes that the stay happened.

cases.draft: Lift L3 was stopped at the roof landing.
cases.note: One source confirms a truthful actual-position display C; the other maps C exclusively to the cellar, not the roof. Both are needed. The draft is undated, so possible_conflict is acceptable for this ordinary case.

cases.draft: Valra Holt numbered the umbrella hooks in the entrance hall at 19:20 on 2 December.
cases.note: Numbered cards above the hooks directly support numbering the hooks; the draft makes no claim about coat pegs.

cases.draft: Every replacement glass pane for window Thistrel arrived intact.
cases.note: An undamaged outer crate and a delivery receipt do not establish each pane's internal condition; the missing inspection could reveal either intact or damaged glass.
